name: auto-reaction-bot
description: Telegram Auto Reaction Bot with group/channel settings, welcome, join requests. Deploys on Vercel (MongoDB) or Cloudflare Workers (D1).

scripts.check: node --check api/index.js && node --check api/worker.js && node --check api/bot-handler.js && node --check api/TelegramBotAPI.js && node --check api/store-mongo.js && node --check api/store-d1.js && node --check api/broadcast.js && node --check api/helper.js && node --check api/constants.js && node --check api/font.js && node --check api/logger.js

BOT_TOKEN.description: Required Telegram Bot API token from @BotFather. Keep this secret.

BOT_USERNAME.description: Telegram bot username without @, for example ReactionsXBot.

EMOJI_LIST.description: Emoji reactions the bot can use. Leave the default list or replace it with your preferred emojis.

ADMIN_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs allowed to use /stats and /broadcast. Optional.

RESTRICTED_CHATS.description: Comma-separated Telegram chat IDs where reactions should be disabled. Optional.

RANDOM_LEVEL.description: Reaction randomness level from 0 to 10. 0 reacts to every eligible message.

UPDATES_URL.description: Telegram URL used by the Updates button in /start.

SUPPORT_URL.description: Optional Telegram support URL used by the Support button.

START_ANIMATION.description: Optional direct animation URL or Telegram file_id for /start.

DONATE_ANIMATION.description: Optional direct animation URL or Telegram file_id for /donate.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level: silent, error, warn, info or debug.

AUTO_SET_WEBHOOK.description: Automatically set Telegram webhook to the deployed Worker URL when the Worker is opened.
